texts.preamble: National Federation Of Farmers ... vs The State Of Maharashtra And on 13 January, 2022 Author: Madhav J. Jamdar Bench: G.S. Patel, Madhav J. Jamdar 904-Aswp-246-2 Ashwini In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay Civil Appellate Jurisdiction Writ Petition No. 246 Of 2022 National Federation of Farmers Procurement and ...Pe Retailing Co-operative of India Ltd Versus The State of Maharashtra & Ors ...Respo Mr Prasad Dhakephalkar, Senior Advocate, with Pradeep J Thorat, i/b Aditi S Naikare, for the Petitioner.
texts.facts: 1 The Petition relates to an e-tender issued under a notice dated 18th March 2021 by the State of Maharashtra for transportation of rice from Food Corporation of India godowns and for the supply of other food grains, pulses, oil, spices and condiments to schools under the mid-day meal scheme in 13th January 2022 904-ASWP-246-2022.DOC Nashik District. The tender was for one year and was to cover 3983 schools. The estimated cost was Rs.36.92 crores. 3. The contest today is between the Petitioners and the 3rd Respondent. That Respondent has been served and given notice. None is present on its behalf today. 4. Mr Kakade confirms that as of today no tender has yet been issued. The statement is noted. 5. Technical bids were opened on 30th September 2021. Commercial or financial bids were opened on 22nd November 2021. The Petitioner itself says in paragraph 10 that it obtained the documents submitted by the 3rd Respondent from the online portal. It noticed several discrepancies that allegedly rendered 3rd Respondent ineligible. In a pre-bid meeting, in response to queries raised by bidders, the tendering authority clarified that since the process of obtaining FSSAI licenses was time-consuming, and since there were lockdowns in various districts, a receipt or a challan evidencing an application for registration should be submitted and would suffice. 13th January 2022 904-ASWP-246-2022.DOC 6. It appears that the 3rd Respondent did not have a license till as late as 25th November 2021. This means that certainly on the date of opening of the technical bid on 30th September 2021 (and, in fact, even at the date of opening of financial bids on 22nd November 2021), the 3rd Respondent did not hold a valid FSSAI license. 7. Paragraph 10 of the Petition avers that the challan submitted by the 3rd Respondent was dated 16th June 2021 for registration under the FSSAI Act. But the online status of the challan showed that the 3rd Respondent's application had been rejected.
